name: How long does a flooded kitchen cleanup typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a flooded kitchen cleanup typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooded kitchen cleanup varies significantly based on the extent of the water damage, the type of water involved (e.g., clean, gray, black water), and the size of the affected area. A minor cleanup might take 2-3 days for drying and sanitization, while more severe floods requiring structural drying, material removal, and reconstruction could extend to a week or more. A professional assessment will provide a more accurate timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cleanup time for a flooded kitchen varies, from a few days for minor issues to over a week for extensive damage, depending on the severity and type of water.
